Your vault is encrypted on this phone with your master password and a Secret Key made here. Nobody else, not even Soma, can open it.
The two passwords are not the same.
Pick a password of at least 10 characters.
Write it down and keep it safe, with your password: both are needed to open your vault on another device. This phone keeps it sealed in its Keystore.
